batch.title: Reproducible baseline and migration chain
batch.goal: Restore fresh creation, legacy upgrade, type-check, build, tests, route, service-role, and migration gates without unexplained failures.
exitCriteria: A fresh isolated database and representative legacy upgrade complete with reconciliation evidence.
The complete baseline command is repeatable and has no unexplained failures.

findings.solution: Fix file; make typecheck a CI merge gate
acceptanceCriteria: Blocker removed; regression test passes; negative/staging verification passes; equivalent bypass absent.
verificationRequirements: Static + automated negative test + seeded staging verification + explicit sign-off.

findings.title: Both security CI gates red: route registry 11+ unclassified (legacy ceiling 122/122); service-role allowlist 38 new bare imports

findings.title: Production main is materially behind the reconciliation branch
findings.solution: Create controlled reconciliation PR; classify each delta MERGE/SUPERSEDED/MIGRATION/SECURITY_REVIEW/DROP; stage first.
acceptanceCriteria: Launch-critical workflow/security boundary works end-to-end with correct tenant scoping.
verificationRequirements: Unit/integration + seeded two-org persona test + API/DB evidence.

findings.title: RLS-enabled tables with zero policies require explicit service-only vs client-access decision
findings.solution: Document access intent; add least-privilege policies if client-facing or guarantee service-only access with tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Behavior is consistent, documented, tested and free of material integrity/usability/scale defect.

findings.title: Typecheck and build evidence conflicts
findings.solution: Record raw command evidence from the pinned toolchain and reject narrative-only pass claims.
acceptanceCriteria: The registry validator and generated views enforce this control and an evidence receipt proves it.

findings.title: Test failure summaries are internally inconsistent
findings.solution: Store raw test evidence and derive counts; never type narrative counts by hand.
acceptanceCriteria: The registry validator and generated views enforce this control and an evidence receipt proves it.
verificationRequirements: Registry contract test, drift test, and independent audit review.

findings.title: Audit reproduction used divergent paths and dirty workspaces
findings.solution: Pin the checkpoint, branch, staging environment, and evidence commit for every verification run.
acceptanceCriteria: The registry validator and generated views enforce this control and an evidence receipt proves it.

specTasks.title: Establish migration safety process
acceptanceCriteria: Dry run, row counts, unresolved bucket, rollback/forward-fix, lock budget, and verification-query template are checked into engineering documentation.

specTasks.title: Pin and enforce runtime/toolchain
acceptanceCriteria: Node 20.x exact strategy and package manager/lockfile are enforced locally/CI; supported install succeeds without `--legacy-peer-deps`.

specTasks.title: Resolve dependency peer conflict
acceptanceCriteria: @base-ui/react`, `date-fns`, and `react-day-picker` versions have a compatible supported set; clean lockfile install is reproducible.

specTasks.title: Reproduce/fix production build cleanup failure
acceptanceCriteria: Build runs in CI/native supported filesystem from clean checkout and exits 0; if environment-specific, root cause/workaround is documented and guarded by a regression check.

blockers.reason: Historical ENOTEMPTY does not reproduce and clean-CI build is the regression guard, but current integrated Admin/API/service TypeScript errors prevent an exit-0 production build

specTasks.title: Make production env validation intentional
acceptanceCriteria: Required/optional/build-time/runtime secrets/URLs are documented; missing required production variables fail once with clear message before expensive build, not repeated warnings.

specTasks.title: Resolve readiness test/product contract
acceptanceCriteria: Product decides venue-profile/staff blockers; implementation/UI/tests/fixtures/migration use one rule contract and all targeted tests pass.

specTasks.title: Create test-data factory
acceptanceCriteria: Deterministic two-org, multi-role, multi-stop tour includes every sensitive parent/child domain and realistic volume/edge dates/currencies.

blockers.reason: Deterministic minimal/realistic/edge/cross-tenant scenarios now cover 13 parent/child domains, realistic volumes, DST, currencies, protected projections, stale/replay/access edges, and forbid Demo/prod targets; canonical contract persistence plus isolated seed/RLS execution remain required

specTasks.title: Baseline lint and warning budget
acceptanceCriteria: Move to supported ESLint CLI/config; snapshot existing warnings by rule/path; new warnings fail CI and prioritized Admin backlog trends to zero.

specTasks.title: Establish feature-flag policy
acceptanceCriteria: Organization-scoped flags have owner, purpose, environments, default, audit, metrics, rollback, expiry/removal issue and safe unavailable state.

blockers.reason: Governed registry/resolver, acting-context capability APIs, immutable reasoned assignment model, safe unavailable UI, tests, and expand-only manual SQL are complete; isolated branch migration/RLS execution and hosted promotion evidence remain required

specTasks.title: Add database/RLS CI environment
acceptanceCriteria: Migrations apply from empty and supported prior snapshot; direct-role RLS tests run for all personas and parent/child records.

blockers.reason: Reset-free ephemeral migration workflow and real direct-client core RLS suite replace the placeholder; structural tests/YAML pass, but all-domain parent/child execution, prior-snapshot migration, and hosted CI evidence await contract persistence and an isolated runner

specTasks.title: Add migration validation template/tooling
acceptanceCriteria: Preflight counts, locks/timing, batching, resume, unresolved rows, constraints/indexes, rollback/forward-fix and postflight queries are required.

blockers.reason: Versioned per-migration manifests now machine-require owner/reviewer, representative snapshot, preflight counts, lock/timeout/batch/resume/idempotency, quarantine, constraints/indexes, recovery, postflight, and governed exceptions; staging/production gates reject insufficient evidence, but representative isolated timing/resume/advisor artifacts are intentionally pending

specTasks.title: Add API authorization contract harness
acceptanceCriteria: Endpoint inventory declares context/capability/schema/idempotency/audit; CI fails for new unclassified Admin routes.

blockers.reason: TypeScript-AST CI now enforces exact 232 route and route-method parity, rejects duplicates/stale entries, materializes acting context/capability mode/schema IDs/idempotency/audit/owner per method, and prevents growth beyond 122 legacy routes; those legacy handlers still require shared runtime schema/auth/idempotency/audit enforcement and contract tests

specTasks.title: Add secret/dependency/static scans
acceptanceCriteria: Prevent committed secrets and known critical vulnerabilities; exceptions have owner/rationale/expiry and production exploitability review.

blockers.reason: Dedicated workflow now runs full-history Gitleaks, CodeQL security-extended, critical PR dependency review, CycloneDX SBOM retention, and machine-governed expiring exploitability exceptions; successful hosted runs, GitHub security settings, required-check enforcement, and retained artifacts remain external evidence blockers

references.canonicalSource: Validated Admin registry, immutable evidence, and generated presentation views
invariants: No status is promoted by historical narrative claims.
Generated views are reproducible and never hand-edited.
